nodes.label: Frozen brushes / Set-AppTheme
nodes.rationale: WPF freezes shareable brushes on XAML load; replace via Resources.Add() because the indexer stores a PSObject wrapper WPF rejects.

nodes.label: Add-HoverLift stationary wrapper
nodes.rationale: RenderTransform moves the hit-test area, causing MouseEnter/Leave loops; the listener must be a stationary wrapper, and staggered enter moves the inner card (Get-EnterTarget).

nodes.label: Colors via theme resources (DynamicResource / Set-TextFg)
nodes.rationale: Literal #RRGGBB does not change when toggling light/dark.

nodes.label: Activity log (core/Diagnostics/Log.ps1 + LogPanel/LogWindow)
nodes.rationale: Log stores facts not phrases so core/ stays language-agnostic; log lines are intentionally untranslated technical text; save dialog split in three because a modal cannot be tested.

nodes.label: Computed setting Status (optimized/factory/custom/unknown)
nodes.rationale: A setting with -Registry has no -Tags: tags would be an invented version of the same fact. Missing value is factory; nothing to compare is unknown, never custom.

nodes.label: core/ never throws upward
nodes.rationale: An exception escaping core/ would bring down the window; return states read/missing/denied/badpath instead.

nodes.label: $RegistryWriteAllowlist / $RegistryWriteAllowedValues
nodes.rationale: No denylist: what is not listed is not touched; value-level list admits specific values without opening whole branches. Known medium risk: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft prefix is broad.

nodes.label: Test suite (Run-Tests.ps1, no Pester)
nodes.rationale: Windows ships only Pester 3.4; using modern Pester would require Install-Module, which the project avoids. TestKit is ~40 lines.

nodes.label: Errores: fallar pronto, no usar throw para el flujo normal
nodes.norm_label: errores: fallar pronto, no usar throw para el flujo normal

nodes.label: Parámetros tipados y validados en la firma
nodes.norm_label: parametros tipados y validados en la firma

nodes.label: Rendimiento y legibilidad: nada de alias, nada de +=
nodes.norm_label: rendimiento y legibilidad: nada de alias, nada de +=

nodes.label: Reversibilidad: capturar el valor previo antes de tocar
nodes.norm_label: reversibilidad: capturar el valor previo antes de tocar

nodes.label: @@EMBED_DIR / @@EMBED_XAML build markers
nodes.rationale: ps2exe accepts one input file; loading a file by hand works in dev but fails in the compiled .exe, so every .ps1 must live inside one of the seven embedded folders.

nodes.label: Update-UiNow as DoEvents
nodes.rationale: Yields the thread so the progress bar paints; window must be made hit-test-deaf to avoid navigation mid-read.

nodes.label: build.ps1 combine + compile pipeline
nodes.rationale: ps2exe accepts only one input file and the .exe must be portable without carrying ui/ alongside.

nodes.label: CategoryIndex (order/visible/locked)
nodes.rationale: Hiding or removing from the index deletes nothing; unlisted categories still appear at the end so adding a section is just creating a file.

nodes.label: Supply chain: ps2exe pinned 1.0.18, unsigned exe, Semgrep CI
nodes.norm_label: supply chain: ps2exe pinned 1.0.18, unsigned exe, semgrep ci

nodes.label: Harness/AppHost.ps1
nodes.rationale: Reads main.ps1 with the same regexes as build.ps1 so tests load exactly what the program loads and validate the packaging contract; disarms registry writes and command runs.

nodes.label: Tests redirect $AppSettingsPath
nodes.rationale: Without redirection tests would overwrite the user's settings.json with only the key they touched.

nodes.label: Audit recommendations (sign exe, persist rollback, Windows CI, narrow prefix)
nodes.norm_label: audit recommendations (sign exe, persist rollback, windows ci, narrow prefix)

nodes.label: Audit history convention
nodes.rationale: Dated report per audit; SECURITY.md is the living document, reports are snapshots.

nodes.label: actions/checkout pinned by SHA
nodes.rationale: A tag like @v6 can be silently repointed by the action owner (supply chain); bumping requires consciously changing the SHA.

nodes.label: Push trigger without paths filter
nodes.rationale: Repo commits directly to master, so every push must run Semgrep, not only those touching the workflow.

nodes.label: New-ChipMenu / New-ViewMenu deliberate duplication
nodes.rationale: Mechanics differ (commands vs checkboxes); merging would churn a tested component.

nodes.label: Code execution hard prohibitions
nodes.rationale: Running as admin: no Invoke-Expression, no runtime Add-Type, no network, no interpreters, only two process-starting doors each with an allowlist.

nodes.label: Tester agent
nodes.rationale: Reports the truth about code state; reproduces failures but does not fix them; a single-host result is not a verification.

nodes.label: versionado skill
nodes.rationale: Public GitHub remote: always commit locally, push only when asked; never force-push/amend/rebase published history.

nodes.label: One commit by default policy
nodes.rationale: Split only for truly independent work; more than 2 commits per normal session is over-splitting.

nodes.label: SupportsShouldProcess: -WhatIf y -Confirm gratis
nodes.community_name: Reglas de dos hosts y calidad

nodes.label: graphify graph usage limits
nodes.rationale: No edge connects code to documentation, so natural-language queries return doc nodes and miss code; use path/explain on code symbols only, and refresh with --update.

nodes.label: Sidebar built in code from NavigationIndex
nodes.norm_label: sidebar built in code from navigationindex
nodes.rationale: An entry without View does not navigate; never route to a filler view or menu and screen would disagree. Animate Border width, not Grid column.

nodes.label: Global search (flat index, ui/Engine/Search.ps1)
nodes.rationale: Indexes both translated and original text; repaint body not header to keep focus; reopen popup via GotFocus plus PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown and defer opening with Dispatcher.BeginInvoke to avoid flicker.

nodes.label: No .GetNewClosure() in event handlers (pass data via Tag)
nodes.norm_label: no .getnewclosure() in event handlers (pass data via tag)
nodes.rationale: Closures bind to a dynamic module where script functions are invisible; only visible running main.ps1, not the .exe.

nodes.label: Test on both hosts (5.1 .exe and pwsh 7 main.ps1)
nodes.norm_label: test on both hosts (5.1 .exe and pwsh 7 main.ps1)
nodes.rationale: The .exe runs in global scope under 5.1 and main.ps1 in script scope under 7; some bugs only appear in one.

nodes.label: UTF-8 with BOM rule
nodes.rationale: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads BOM-less scripts as ANSI, producing mojibake and parser errors that pwsh 7 does not show.

nodes.label: ExternalLink http/https only
nodes.rationale: ShellExecute from an elevated process would open any local exe or file.

nodes.community_name: Analisis estatico y lo no cubierto
nodes.norm_label: why playwright does not apply (wpf, no dom)
nodes.rationale: Playwright automates browsers via DevTools; WPF has no DOM. Building real WPF controls without showing the window answers most questions in seconds.

nodes.label: Security-degrading value-name denylist + AllowsSecurityTradeoff
nodes.rationale: The user accepts an optimizer, not a security downgrade; such settings cannot be Recommended, must state the lost protection and be off by default.

nodes.label: Command-step sections (Internet)
nodes.rationale: Execution order is the file order since steps depend on each other; a DispatcherTimer ticks every 120 ms doing one thing per tick so the window never freezes.

nodes.label: Command execution contract (CommandRunner.ps1)
nodes.rationale: No interpreter, executables by name resolved to System folder never PATH, literal args, services only started, file order, never throws, traced, disarmable.

nodes.label: Ui/Wiring.Tests.ps1
nodes.rationale: Only way to catch rule 4: copies main.ps1 without ShowDialog, appends clicks and runs it in another process.

nodes.label: Mica/Acrylic exclusive with own gradient
nodes.rationale: System material only shows on translucent windows which cannot have their own background; dwmapi call never throws and falls back to opaque.

nodes.rationale: Menos movimiento no es cero: se quedan los fundidos y se va el desplazamiento.

nodes.label: Design system and live theme switch
nodes.norm_label: design system and live theme switch
nodes.rationale: All appearance comes from MainWindow.xaml resources: palette, gradients, Window.Resources brushes, styles, UiKit components, Segoe UI Variable, Segoe Fluent Icons. XAML uses DynamicResource and code SetResourceReference, so Set-AppTheme only rewrites brush colors and the built UI repaints without rebuilding views.

nodes.label: Effects and transitions table
nodes.rationale: Staggered entry, view entry (fade + 14px slide, 260 ms CubicEase), card lift (3px + section-color halo, 170 ms), backdrop (3 radial blobs, 27-41 s, 20 fps), nav indicator (QuinticEase), toggle (ColorAnimation + BackEase), count-up, press-shrink via XAML triggers, 6-8px scrollbar.

nodes.label: Catálogo del peor caso (break-ui)
nodes.rationale: Valores realistas que pueden salir de la traducción, del registro o del uso; adaptado del catálogo de emilkowalski/skills sin emails, avatares, monedas ni RTL.

nodes.label: Skill: break-ui
nodes.rationale: Rompe una pieza de la interfaz con datos del peor caso realista, la pinta a PNG sin ventana y lista qué se rompe; no rediseña ni revisa movimiento.

nodes.label: Skill: review-animations
nodes.rationale: Adaptada de emilkowalski/skills (animations.dev) a WPF; solo revisa el movimiento.

nodes.label: Normas de animación: referencia para WPF
nodes.norm_label: normas de animacion: referencia para wpf

nodes.label: Live backdrop at 20 fps without BlurEffect
nodes.norm_label: live backdrop at 20 fps without blureffect
nodes.rationale: Blobs blur themselves with radial gradients ending in transparent; a big blur over half the screen is the costly part. Timeline::SetDesiredFrameRate caps at 20 fps: nobody tells 20 from 60 over a half-minute path, and repainting the whole window nonstop is unacceptable in a program called Optimizador PC.

nodes.label: Start-CountUp writes the final value without a live window
nodes.norm_label: start-countup writes the final value without a live window
nodes.rationale: Without a message loop the timer never ticks and the number would stay at zero in tests. README: pills count up in 520 ms.

nodes.label: Never declare an animated Freezable in a style Setter
nodes.norm_label: never declare an animated freezable in a style setter
nodes.rationale: RenderTransform/Effect in a Setter are shared by all controls of the style and WPF cannot animate a shared instance: create them per control in code (Add-HoverLift). The press-scale may live in a Setter because the trigger sets it, it does not animate it.

nodes.label: Selectable text: read-only TextBox instead of TextBlock (New-MonoField)
nodes.norm_label: selectable text: read-only textbox instead of textblock (new-monofield)
nodes.rationale: TextBlock has no selection; a borderless transparent read-only TextBox looks the same but supports Ctrl+C. Foreground is the same DependencyProperty for both (Set-TextFg works), Background is not (hence Set-WinBg). The copy notice shows on one button at a time via module state because a DispatcherTimer has no Tag.

nodes.label: Peor caso plausible o con límite real, nunca aleatorio
nodes.norm_label: peor caso plausible o con limite real, nunca aleatorio
nodes.rationale: Datos absurdos no prueban nada; y quedarse en el texto largo olvida '1 ajustes', secciones vacías o textos sin T.

nodes.label: Recortar, partir o limitar: decisión por campo
nodes.norm_label: recortar, partir o limitar: decision por campo
nodes.rationale: Partir el nombre; recortar al final la descripción con ToolTip; recortar en medio rutas; nunca recortar valores ni números.

nodes.label: Postura: por defecto se señala; la aprobación se gana
nodes.norm_label: postura: por defecto se senala; la aprobacion se gana
nodes.rationale: Un movimiento que gasta CPU sin motivo contradice a un optimizador (regla 26).

nodes.label: Las animaciones no avanzan sin una ventana pintándose
nodes.norm_label: las animaciones no avanzan sin una ventana pintandose
nodes.rationale: Por eso colapsar el velo del log está en Close-LogOverlay y no en el manejador de la animación.

nodes.label: Nunca un Freezable dentro de un Setter que vayas a animar
nodes.norm_label: nunca un freezable dentro de un setter que vayas a animar

nodes.label: Al plegar el menú se anima el ancho del Border, nunca la columna
nodes.norm_label: al plegar el menu se anima el ancho del border, nunca la columna

nodes.label: Staggered entry never moves the card wrapper (Get-EnterTarget)
nodes.norm_label: staggered entry never moves the card wrapper (get-entertarget)
nodes.rationale: Start-StaggeredEnter delays each child; Get-EnterTarget moves the inner card when the child is the Add-HoverLift wrapper (Uid 'lift'), else the hit area would enter the rule-21 loop. A test guards it. README: 45 ms apart, 300 ms each.

nodes.label: Al implementar optimizaciones (core/, New-Setting, Writer.ps1, AllowsSecurityTradeoff)
nodes.norm_label: al implementar optimizaciones (core/, new-setting, writer.ps1, allowssecuritytradeoff)
nodes.rationale: Escritura por lista blanca, tipo declarado, snapshot y relectura; servicios, energía y red serán subcarpetas nuevas de core/.

nodes.label: Layer 4 System: core/ (talks to Windows)
nodes.rationale: Does not know the UI (not one WPF control), returns data and never throws upward. Split by what it touches in Windows: Registry, Interop (Mica/Acrylic, work-area maximize), Shell (http/https links only), Commands, Diagnostics. A new mechanism (services, power) is a new subfolder that enters the .exe on its own.

nodes.label: Peor caso: valores del registro (rutas largas, DWord 0xFFFFFFFF, missing/denied/badpath)
nodes.norm_label: peor caso: valores del registro (rutas largas, dword 0xffffffff, missing/denied/badpath)

nodes.label: Estado hoy: tres mecanismos que tocan el equipo, cada uno con lista blanca
nodes.norm_label: estado hoy: tres mecanismos que tocan el equipo, cada uno con lista blanca
nodes.rationale: Registro (47 ajustes con -Registry, uno por clave), comandos sin shell y borrado de carpetas de lista blanca.

nodes.label: NetworkThrottlingIndex = 0xFFFFFFFF (Network Throttling Mechanism)
nodes.rationale: Único ajuste vivo revisado: sin riesgo de seguridad, reversible a 0x0000000A.

nodes.label: Orden de revisión de un diff y formato de hallazgo
nodes.norm_label: orden de revision de un diff y formato de hallazgo

nodes.label: Pending work (rollback, restore point, Update -Registry, ...)
nodes.rationale: Persistent rollback and undo; restore-point warning before the first elevated write; -Registry for Actualizaciones; services/tasks/policies as new core/ subfolders; real values for settings without -Registry; Quick Actions and Reset; computed list counters; .exe smoke test with UI Automation; search over steps and guides; remember ticked steps; a back-to-DHCP step.

nodes.label: Registry write contract (Writer.ps1 / SettingApply.ps1)
nodes.rationale: Only Writer.ps1 writes (one key per call), triggered by SettingApply.ps1 toggles. 47 settings with -Registry, all in the Regedit section, one setting per key; NetworkThrottlingIndex was the first wired (benign, reversible).

nodes.label: DWord arrives as signed Int32 (Format-RegistryValue)
nodes.rationale: 0xFFFFFFFF reads as -1; reinterpret unsigned or high values look negative and do not match the declared ones.

nodes.label: @() over a New-Object List[object] throws (use .ToArray())
nodes.rationale: Fails in 5.1 and 7 because New-Object returns a PSObject wrapper; List[string], ArrayList or ::new() work, so it only bites in some places. foreach, pipeline and returning it work.

nodes.label: Comma inside method parentheses separates arguments (-f pitfall)
nodes.norm_label: comma inside method parentheses separates arguments (-f pitfall)
nodes.rationale: $list.Add('{0} de {1}' -f $a, $b) keeps only the first value; build the string first. Calling a command is fine because there the parentheses wrap an expression.

nodes.label: One setting per registry key (never group keys)
nodes.norm_label: one setting per registry key (never group keys)
nodes.rationale: Each -Registry setting maps to exactly one key (today the 47 of Regedit). README status rules still describe multi-key settings (optimized/factory only if all keys agree), a path this policy leaves unused.

nodes.label: Always open RegistryView::Registry64
nodes.rationale: A 32-bit .exe would silently redirect HKLM\SOFTWARE to Wow6432Node.

nodes.label: Every registry/service change must be reversible (Default + snapshot)
nodes.norm_label: every registry/service change must be reversible (default + snapshot)
nodes.rationale: The registry contract is each key's Default (where OFF returns) plus Writer.ps1's in-memory snapshot of the previous value. Pending: persist the snapshot and expose undo; today it is lost on close.

nodes.label: DWord llega como Int32 con signo
nodes.norm_label: dword llega como int32 con signo

nodes.label: Ajustes que degradan la seguridad (denylist y AllowsSecurityTradeoff)
nodes.norm_label: ajustes que degradan la seguridad (denylist y allowssecuritytradeoff)
nodes.rationale: No pueden llamarse Recommended sin más, deben decir qué se pierde y no estar activos por defecto; se comprueba el número, no el nombre.

nodes.label: Cadena de suministro: ps2exe fijado a 1.0.18, .exe sin firma
nodes.norm_label: cadena de suministro: ps2exe fijado a 1.0.18, .exe sin firma
nodes.rationale: Sin firma Authenticode se bloquea distribuir a terceros.

nodes.label: Prohibiciones de ejecución de código (iex, Add-Type dinámico, descargas)
nodes.norm_label: prohibiciones de ejecucion de codigo (iex, add-type dinamico, descargas)

nodes.label: Datos del usuario: settings.json en %APPDATA%, log exportable, sin telemetría
nodes.norm_label: datos del usuario: settings.json en %appdata%, log exportable, sin telemetria

nodes.label: Las cinco condiciones de cada escritura al registro
nodes.norm_label: las cinco condiciones de cada escritura al registro
nodes.rationale: Restauración documentada, missing vs read, lista blanca, tipo declarado, nada de ACLs. Preferir HKCU a HKLM. Pendiente: borrar al revertir lo que no existía, reg export y punto de restauración.

nodes.label: Modelo de amenaza del .exe elevado y portable
nodes.norm_label: modelo de amenaza del .exe elevado y portable
nodes.rationale: -requireAdmin, -noConsole y portable: riesgos por gravedad: dejar el equipo menos seguro, dejarlo roto sin vuelta atrás, ejecutar código ajeno como admin.

nodes.label: Sync-LogView: new log lines are not painted by themselves
nodes.norm_label: sync-logview: new log lines are not painted by themselves
nodes.rationale: Write-AppLog records in core/ and nobody notifies the UI; the drawer hides it (Show-LogPanel rebuilds on open) but the detached window would go stale, so whoever reads the system notifies (today Show-CategoryDetailView, next to Reset-SearchIndex). Sync-LogView rebuilds nothing without new entries (compares Get-AppLogSequence and count), since it runs each tick.

nodes.label: Five conditions of each registry write
nodes.norm_label: five conditions of each registry write
nodes.rationale: Documented Default for restore; distinguish missing vs other value (pending: revert of non-existing value should delete); path validated against allowlist with Registry64; declared type respected (typemismatch, MultiString unsupported); never touch ACLs/owners. Plus snapshot, read-back verification and -WhatIf.

nodes.label: ContentDock: fixed frame for the step-run panel
nodes.norm_label: contentdock: fixed frame for the step-run panel
nodes.rationale: A fixed slot above the scrolling area in the content column; placed in the header it pushed the sidebar. Set-PageDock fills it, Clear-PageHeader empties it.

nodes.label: List or grid is a view option, not a separate view
nodes.norm_label: list or grid is a view option, not a separate view
nodes.rationale: OptimizationsListView reads the 'grid' option and picks panel (StackPanel/WrapPanel) and piece (CategoryCard/CategoryTile); both share New-CategoryStats so they never count differently. In grid the description has a fixed height so rows do not jag.

nodes.label: Guides section (Guias, ui/Data/Guides .md)
nodes.rationale: One card per .md; adding a guide = dropping the .md and recompiling (the .exe embeds them). Content belongs to the user and never passes through T (Set-PageBreadcrumb -RawTitle / -BackView); only the frame is translated.

nodes.label: Markdown reader subset (Get-MarkdownBlocks)
nodes.rationale: Understands what the guides use, not all CommonMark. Own decision: inside a paragraph a line starting with ** opens a new line. Named Get-MarkdownBlocks because ConvertFrom-Markdown exists in PowerShell 7. A RichTextBox keeps the mouse wheel, so Send-MarkdownWheel forwards it to the page.

nodes.label: Parameter-name case pitfall ([string]$Title vs $title)
nodes.rationale: PowerShell variables are case-insensitive: a [string]$Title parameter turns any inner $title into text. It broke every breadcrumb at once in Set-PageBreadcrumb.

nodes.label: Defined categories (Regedit, Internet, Cleanup, Power, Update)
nodes.norm_label: defined categories (regedit, internet, cleanup, power, update)
nodes.rationale: Regedit 47 settings, Internet 27 steps, Cleanup 15 steps, Power 2 steps, Update 2 settings. Badges count settings with -Badge 'NEW' unless declared by hand; list pill counters are still fixed values while the detail row counts real status.

nodes.label: Declaring a section (Register-Category, New-Setting)
nodes.rationale: New-Setting infers the control: with -Options a dropdown, without it a toggle. Only Id, Name, Icon, Description and Items are required.

nodes.label: Guides shown as text only (Base64 in exe, never executed)
nodes.norm_label: guides shown as text only (base64 in exe, never executed)
nodes.rationale: Guide .md files are embedded as Base64, parsed by Markdown.ps1 into a read-only RichTextBox and never executed; their links pass through Invoke-ExternalLink.

nodes.label: BF6 network tweaks .reg file
nodes.rationale: The user's original .reg referenced across guides; likely bf6_network_tweaks.reg in the workspace root, outside the repo.

nodes.label: LanmanServer SMB parameters (autodisconnect, Size, EnableOplocks, IRPStackSize, SharingViolation*)
nodes.norm_label: lanmanserver smb parameters (autodisconnect, size, enableoplocks, irpstacksize, sharingviolation*)
nodes.rationale: File-sharing server settings; irrelevant to game latency.

nodes.label: MMCSS Tasks\Games (GPU Priority, Priority, Scheduling Category, SFIO Priority)
nodes.norm_label: mmcss tasks\games (gpu priority, priority, scheduling category, sfio priority)

nodes.label: Multimedia SystemProfile: NetworkThrottlingIndex / SystemResponsiveness (MMCSS)

nodes.norm_label: que el archivo nuevo entre al .exe (marcadores embed_dir, embed_guides, embed_xaml)

nodes.label: Seven-layer architecture (one folder per layer)
nodes.rationale: From data to screen; never skip a layer downward; the folder name says what may be inside. A view creating controls by hand belongs in Components; a component knowing concrete categories by Id belongs in the category file.

nodes.label: Layer load order decided by main.ps1
nodes.norm_label: layer load order decided by main.ps1
nodes.rationale: Each layer loads whole via an @@EMBED_DIR block, so a new .ps1 enters on its own. main.ps1 only decides the order of the seven loads, which matters because data registers on load (Categories call Register-Category in Engine). Inside a folder order is alphabetical and irrelevant: the index decides the visible order. A test guards the inter-layer order.

nodes.label: Locked is not decorative (IsEnabled = $false on the controls panel)
nodes.norm_label: locked is not decorative (isenabled = $false on the controls panel)
nodes.rationale: New-SettingCard -Locked disables the controls panel and WPF stops delivering the mouse to the whole subtree; new controls on the setting card must hang from that panel to inherit the lock.

nodes.label: Qué se rompe al mover, renombrar o borrar archivos
nodes.norm_label: que se rompe al mover, renombrar o borrar archivos

nodes.norm_label: que no refactorizar por tu cuenta (marcadores y excepciones conscientes)

nodes.norm_label: el menu lateral se construye por codigo (registername nav<id>)

nodes.label: Tests never touch the user's settings, network or registry
nodes.norm_label: tests never touch the user's settings, network or registry
nodes.rationale: AppHost redirects $AppSettingsPath to a PID-named temp file, else a test would rewrite settings.json with a single key (the harness never calls Import-AppSettings). The Wiring.Tests probe, a copy of main.ps1 in another process, gets the redirection injected before its Import-AppSettings (it used to change the user's theme). The harness disarms commands (Set-CommandRunArmed $false) and pauses.

nodes.norm_label: threat model (elevated, no console, portable, unsigned)
nodes.rationale: ps2exe -requireAdmin -noConsole single-file exe without Authenticode. Real risks by severity: 1) leaving the PC less secure (UAC/Defender/SmartScreen/firewall/Update off), 2) leaving it broken without rollback, 3) running foreign code as admin.

Selection is set by Sync-NavSelection from Show-View, not by the click, since screens can be reached without the menu.

nodes.label: Command-step sections (Internet, Limpieza, Energia)
nodes.rationale: A section that declares Steps instead of Items is a checklist of commands plus a run button, ported one command per step from loose scripts (Reiniciar_Red_v3.cmd, EliminarTemporales.v1.cmd, maximo rendimiento de enerigia.bat). Execution order is the file order whatever the user ticks, because steps depend on each other. Use Test-CategoryHasSteps: @($null).Count is 1. Tests disarm execution and never touch the network.

nodes.label: Folder cleanup (FolderCleanup.ps1, the only place that deletes files)
nodes.norm_label: folder cleanup (foldercleanup.ps1, the only place that deletes files)
nodes.rationale: Empties profile temp folders and the recycle bin through a folder allowlist, in chunks, inside the user folder; -Clean and -EmptyRecycleBin default to -RequiresAdmin $false.

nodes.label: Test coverage (core, UI, main.ps1 wiring, rules, security invariants)
nodes.norm_label: test coverage (core, ui, main.ps1 wiring, rules, security invariants)
nodes.rationale: core/ against the real registry (read states, signed DWord, writes against an HKCU branch); UI with real WPF controls without a window; main.ps1 wiring by pressing buttons (only way to catch convention 4); source rules (BOM, closures, glyphs, nothing left out of the .exe); security invariants (allowlisted -Registry paths, no dynamic code or network in ui/core, ExternalLink only http/https). Playwright does not apply (WPF, no DOM).

nodes.label: Optimizador PC working context (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: WPF desktop app in PowerShell 5.1 compiled to a portable .exe with ps2exe. State: complete UI plus bounded real changes; three mechanisms touch the machine (registry, commands, deletion), each with its own allowlist.

nodes.label: SECURITY.md (threat model and contracts)
nodes.rationale: Living security document cited by CLAUDE.md and README.md: read before touching registry writes; section 4 security-degrading settings, section 12 command allowlist.

nodes.label: Security and quality audits (auditoria/ dated reports)
nodes.norm_label: security and quality audits (auditoria/ dated reports)
nodes.rationale: Each pass leaves a dated report in auditoria/ and a row in auditoria/README.md to record what was reviewed and fixed; SECURITY.md is the living document, reports are snapshots.

nodes.label: Command allowlists ($CommandAllowedExecutables / $CommandAllowedServices)
nodes.rationale: Adding an executable or service is a security decision (SECURITY.md section 12); Security.Tests.ps1 fails if a step does not pass the allowlist.

nodes.label: OptimizadorPC.exe: portable, elevated, console-less (-requireAdmin -noConsole)
nodes.rationale: Any real tweak runs elevated, so be conservative. Without a console Write-Host is invisible: debug by running main.ps1.

nodes.label: Registry write via allowlist (SettingApply -> Writer)
nodes.rationale: The app runs elevated, so writes only go through an allowlist of branches and concrete values ($RegistryWriteAllowlist), respect the declared type, keep the previous value in memory ($RegistrySnapshots), verify by re-reading and support -WhatIf. Toggle ON writes Recommended, OFF writes Default. Widening the allowlist is a security decision, not a detail (read SECURITY.md first).

nodes.label: Security-degrading settings must be declared (never plain Recommended)
nodes.norm_label: security-degrading settings must be declared (never plain recommended)
nodes.rationale: Settings lowering UAC, Defender, SmartScreen, Windows Update or BitLocker must say which protection is lost and cannot be on by default; Security.Tests.ps1 checks no -Registry touches those value names undeclared (SECURITY.md section 4).

nodes.label: Glyph catalog (Segoe Fluent Icons), never emoji
nodes.norm_label: glyph catalog (segoe fluent icons), never emoji
nodes.rationale: Check a new codepoint with GlyphTypeface.CharacterToGlyphMap and look at it rendered: E7ED is a crossed-out bell, the plain bell is EA8F.

nodes.label: The log drawer is not a view (Close-LogOverlay)
nodes.norm_label: the log drawer is not a view (close-logoverlay)
nodes.rationale: It sits on top of the screen without going through Router.ps1, so Update-UiLanguage rebuilds it separately (Show-CurrentView does not). Collapsing the veil lives in Close-LogOverlay, not the animation handler, because animations do not advance without a painted window: separating it makes closing testable.

nodes.label: Router: Show-View and language repaint (Update-UiLanguage)
nodes.rationale: Views are shown with Show-View, never called directly, or the router loses track and a language change repaints the wrong screen. Colors follow DynamicResource but text does not: Update-UiLanguage rebuilds the menu and redraws the current view, deferred to the Dispatcher because it fires from a control in the view being destroyed.

nodes.label: Sliding indicator needs measurements (Move-NavIndicator)
nodes.rationale: TranslatePoint is zero before WPF measures (main.ps1 paints the first screen before the window exists), so the indicator hides and returns via SizeChanged, hooked once (flag in the Border Tag). It animates only on navigation, since collapse fires SizeChanged dozens of times.

nodes.label: Sidebar collapse animates the Border width, not the Grid column
nodes.norm_label: sidebar collapse animates the border width, not the grid column
nodes.rationale: The Auto column follows the Border; WPF has no GridLength animation. The 1px right border goes to 0 or the width never reaches zero. README: 220 ms CubicEase, 88 px to 0, content fades slightly earlier.

nodes.label: Search box Tag belongs to the popup, not the placeholder
nodes.norm_label: search box tag belongs to the popup, not the placeholder
nodes.rationale: New-SearchBox hides its placeholder by looking among siblings to keep Tag free, because New-SearchBar stores its Popup there; two owners of one slot break one of them.

nodes.label: Search popup: debounce, Enter, Escape, reopen on click
nodes.norm_label: search popup: debounce, enter, escape, reopen on click
nodes.rationale: First rows ($SearchPopupMax), Enter goes to the full page, Escape only swallowed if something was open, debounce ($SearchDebounceMs). Reopening on click needs GotFocus AND PreviewMouseLeftButtonDown because most of the window is not focusable and the box may never lose focus. Programmatic focus (Set-SearchFocus) is flagged once by $SearchFocusIsProgrammatic.

nodes.label: Popup opening deferred via Dispatcher.BeginInvoke ($script:SearchReopenBox)
nodes.rationale: Opening inside the triggering mouse event flickers: StaysOpen's outside-click hook sees the still-routing click. Request-SearchPopupReopen defers with BeginInvoke (Input priority). A scriptblock cast to [action] loses local variables, so $Box would arrive empty and Update-SearchPopup silently do nothing; the box travels via $script:SearchReopenBox, like Start-SearchDebounce with $script:SearchPendingBox.

nodes.label: Test popups by popup.Child, not IsOpen
nodes.norm_label: test popups by popup.child, not isopen
nodes.rationale: IsOpen creates its own Windows window only with a shown window, which no test has, so the property does not stick; Update-SearchPopup rebuilds Child before touching IsOpen.

nodes.label: Typing repaints the body, never the header
nodes.norm_label: typing repaints the body, never the header
nodes.rationale: Rebuilding the header destroys the text box with its focus and caret: Show-SearchResultsView paints both, Update-SearchResults only the body, and the count goes in the body.

nodes.label: Clicking a result opens its section with the setting highlighted
nodes.norm_label: clicking a result opens its section with the setting highlighted
nodes.rationale: New-SettingCard -Highlight adds an accent border; the scroll into view is deferred to the Dispatcher because Show-View scrolls to the top after the view finishes.

nodes.label: Normalize-PsEncoding PostToolUse hook
nodes.rationale: Leaves each .ps1/.xaml in UTF-8 with BOM and CRLF on write. It lives in OptimizadorPC/.claude/settings.local.json, so a session opened from Escritorio\Temp does not load it (2026-10-03: new .ps1 files lost the BOM, caught by Rules.Tests.ps1), nor agents or permissions. Open the session from OptimizadorPC/. sed -i keeps the BOM but leaves LF.

nodes.label: Agent delegation policy (only for 2+ independent fronts)
nodes.norm_label: agent delegation policy (only for 2+ independent fronts)
nodes.rationale: An agent starts cold and must rediscover the project, so for one or two files it costs more than doing it. Delegate only with two or more fronts that do not touch each other, launched at once; Claude decides alone.

nodes.label: How to work fast here (ordered time-savers)
nodes.norm_label: how to work fast here (ordered time-savers)
nodes.rationale: Independent calls go in the same turn; tests with -BothHosts; encoding fixed by the hook; skills at start. The real brake is permissions: a command missing from .claude/settings.local.json stops the session, so repeated read-only commands belong in that list.

nodes.label: Skills load at task start (break-ui render.ps1 as screenshot)
nodes.norm_label: skills load at task start (break-ui render.ps1 as screenshot)
nodes.rationale: Skills enter the turn without cold start: windows-desktop-architect for UI, powershell-engineer for any .ps1, exploracion for reading, versionado for commits, review-animations for motion, break-ui for worst-case data; break-ui's render.ps1 paints a piece to PNG without opening the window.

nodes.label: Run tests on both hosts (-BothHosts)
nodes.rationale: The exe runs on 5.1 with everything in global scope; main.ps1 runs on pwsh 7 in script scope; some failures appear in only one (CLAUDE.md rule 8).

nodes.label: Shell containers (HeaderTitleArea, HeaderActionsArea, MainContent) via PageHeader
nodes.norm_label: shell containers (headertitlearea, headeractionsarea, maincontent) via pageheader
nodes.rationale: Views are built in code and injected into three named containers through PageHeader.ps1, so changing screens never recreates the window and all screens share the header.

nodes.label: Las reglas que más se incumplen
nodes.norm_label: las reglas que mas se incumplen
nodes.rationale: BOM, sin GetNewClosure, nunca editar build/_combined.ps1, texto por T, colores por tema, Glyph, core/ no lanza, .Add() | Out-Null.

nodes.label: No usar GetNewClosure: el dato viaja por el Tag
nodes.norm_label: no usar getnewclosure: el dato viaja por el tag
nodes.rationale: Un closure queda ligado a un módulo dinámico y no ve las funciones del script; falla solo en main.ps1.

nodes.label: Iconos: Glyph del catálogo de Theme.ps1, nunca emoji
nodes.norm_label: iconos: glyph del catalogo de theme.ps1, nunca emoji

nodes.label: Todo texto visible pasa por T y hay que repintar al cambiar de idioma
nodes.norm_label: todo texto visible pasa por t y hay que repintar al cambiar de idioma

nodes.label: Pinceles congelados: Resources.Add en vez del indexador
nodes.norm_label: pinceles congelados: resources.add en vez del indexador

nodes.label: Un Popup tiene que colgar del árbol lógico
nodes.norm_label: un popup tiene que colgar del arbol logico

nodes.label: Peor caso: nombres y descripciones de ajustes (el español es lo que se rompe)
nodes.norm_label: peor caso: nombres y descripciones de ajustes (el espanol es lo que se rompe)

nodes.label: Eliminar un concepto de todo el proyecto (receta de la etiqueta Preference)
nodes.norm_label: eliminar un concepto de todo el proyecto (receta de la etiqueta preference)

nodes.label: Los olores propios de este proyecto
nodes.norm_label: los olores propios de este proyecto

nodes.label: Las siete capas, de datos a pantalla
nodes.norm_label: las siete capas, de datos a pantalla
nodes.rationale: Nunca saltar una capa hacia abajo; olores: vista creando controles, componente mirando Id de categorías.

nodes.label: graphify graph: what it is for and what not
nodes.norm_label: graphify graph: what it is for and what not
nodes.rationale: Useful: path/explain on code symbols, graph.html, god nodes Set-TextFg(), T(), Window. Not useful: natural-language query, how-it-works questions, finding where things go, data files (loose nodes; grep them). Queries failed because no edge linked docs and code. Order: CLAUDE.md, direct search, then the graph. The graph ages silently: run /graphify . --update after code changes.

nodes.label: Log entry detail (Items) folded with New-DetailList
nodes.norm_label: log entry detail (items) folded with new-detaillist
nodes.rationale: Lines shown on request: files a cleanup deleted or skipped (Get-CleanupItems), recycle-bin contents, full program output (Get-CommandOutputItems), under the log entry and the step row. Open state lives in $DetailListOpen by key (log:<Id>, step:<section>:<step>) because the log is rebuilt and would close itself; entry Ids never repeat.

nodes.label: Playwright (not applicable to WPF)
nodes.community_name: Analisis estatico y lo no cubierto
nodes.rationale: Automates browsers via DevTools and DOM selectors; WPF has no DOM. Same for Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer.

nodes.label: Programa/OptimizadorPC.ps1 (versión monolítica con Apply/Revert, Set-Reg, Set-SvcState)
nodes.norm_label: programa/optimizadorpc.ps1 (version monolitica con apply/revert, set-reg, set-svcstate)

nodes.label: Arquitectura de siete capas (Design, Engine, Index, core, Data, Components, Views)
nodes.norm_label: arquitectura de siete capas (design, engine, index, core, data, components, views)

nodes.label: Preguntas que responde cada plan (capa, declarativo, estados de core/, qué se rompe)
nodes.norm_label: preguntas que responde cada plan (capa, declarativo, estados de core/, que se rompe)

nodes.label: Agente arquitecto (solo lectura)
nodes.rationale: Entrega un plan que el dev pueda ejecutar sin volver a decidir; no escribe código ni toca archivos.

nodes.label: Optimización fuera del registro = mecanismo nuevo en core/
nodes.norm_label: optimizacion fuera del registro = mecanismo nuevo en core/
nodes.rationale: Adaptador de red, servicios, energía o tareas no se meten a la fuerza en el lector de registro.

nodes.label: Orden de carga de capas
nodes.rationale: Los datos se registran al cargarse: ui/Data necesita ui/Engine ya cargado; invertir capas rompe el arranque.

nodes.label: Preferir el archivo declarativo al código; un plan que no cabe en una pantalla son dos
nodes.norm_label: preferir el archivo declarativo al codigo; un plan que no cabe en una pantalla son dos

nodes.label: FolderCleanup.ps1 sole deletion gate ($CleanupAllowedFolders)
nodes.rationale: Deleting from an elevated process is irreversible, so one place with a folder allowlist: only %TEMP%/%LOCALAPPDATA%/%APPDATA%, always inside the user profile, links never followed, folders emptied not removed, in-use files skipped, 80 ms chunks; recycle bin via Clear-RecycleBin, never pre-checked. Replaces the .cmd del /q.

nodes.label: Power section: powercfg Ultimate Performance at fixed GUID
nodes.norm_label: power section: powercfg ultimate performance at fixed guid
nodes.rationale: Only /duplicatescheme of the hidden Ultimate Performance template to a fixed program GUID and /setactive of it; never deletes or edits other plans.

nodes.label: -SkipIf read-only registry check
nodes.rationale: A step may declare a registry value; if present the step ends succeeded ('already in place'). Exists because powercfg returns the same code for 'already exists' as for any failure. Read only, after the disarm check.

nodes.label: Command output read as bytes, decoded afterwards
nodes.norm_label: command output read as bytes, decoded afterwards
nodes.rationale: netsh writes UTF-8 when launched from a 65001 terminal and OEM 850 from the console-less .exe.

nodes.label: Never an interpreter (no cmd /c, no powershell -c)
nodes.norm_label: never an interpreter (no cmd /c, no powershell -c)
nodes.rationale: Executables start directly by full system path, each argument a separate -Arguments element; pipes or 'if errorlevel' from the .cmd become other step types (services use -Service, which checks Get-Service).

nodes.label: -SkipIf skips already-done steps (Energia power plan at fixed GUID)
nodes.norm_label: -skipif skips already-done steps (energia power plan at fixed guid)
nodes.rationale: The original .bat created a new copy of the Ultimate Performance plan on every run; the step uses a fixed GUID and -SkipIf (a registry value) to skip it if already present.

nodes.label: Todo lo que no se consume se devuelve (Out-Null)
nodes.norm_label: todo lo que no se consume se devuelve (out-null)

nodes.label: Diagnostics and error reporting tasks (DiskDiagnosticDataCollector, QueueReporting)
nodes.norm_label: diagnostics and error reporting tasks (diskdiagnosticdatacollector, queuereporting)

nodes.label: App privacy: force-deny Windows apps in background
nodes.norm_label: app privacy: force-deny windows apps in background

nodes.label: Saving the log to a file (Guardar como, Export-AppLog)
nodes.norm_label: saving the log to a file (guardar como, export-applog)
nodes.rationale: Writes the whole buffer, not the painted rows. The dialog is split in three (New-LogSaveDialog builds, Read-LogSaveResult interprets - cancel is $null -, Save-AppLogTo writes) because a modal cannot be tested. Get-AppLogFileName suggests opt-<date>.log without colons. Folder remembered as LogSaveFolder via Set-AppSetting, falling back to the real Desktop (inside OneDrive). Empty log: Update-LogSaveButton disables the button and Export-AppLog refuses anyway (guarantee in core/). 'With detail' (LogExportDetails) indents detail lines; format [date] [LEVEL] [SOURCE] [status] via Format-AppLogLine.

nodes.label: Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE / Green Ethernet) disabled
nodes.norm_label: energy efficient ethernet (eee / green ethernet) disabled
nodes.rationale: Link wake-ups add intermittent jitter; classic cause of random ping spikes.

nodes.label: Flow Control disabled
nodes.rationale: Pause frames can halt transmission under saturation; let TCP handle congestion.

nodes.label: Large Send Offload V2 (IPv4/IPv6) disabled
nodes.rationale: Grouping large segments adds latency.

nodes.label: Firmas de rotura: lo que se ve, causa y arreglo WPF
nodes.norm_label: firmas de rotura: lo que se ve, causa y arreglo wpf

nodes.label: Colores siempre por recurso de tema
nodes.norm_label: colores siempre por recurso de tema

nodes.label: Declaración New-Setting con -Registry, Recommended y Default
nodes.norm_label: declaracion new-setting con -registry, recommended y default
nodes.rationale: El Current no se declara: lo lee CategoryState.ps1 al entrar en la sección.

nodes.label: No inventar rutas del registro ni valores de fábrica (pendiente de verificar)
nodes.norm_label: no inventar rutas del registro ni valores de fabrica (pendiente de verificar)
nodes.rationale: Si falta un dato que cambia el diseño (¿HKCU o HKLM?), se pregunta: no se elige por defecto en algo irreversible.

nodes.label: Sin valor de restauración real no se puede aplicar un ajuste
nodes.norm_label: sin valor de restauracion real no se puede aplicar un ajuste

nodes.label: Se cambian los datos, no la pieza
nodes.norm_label: se cambian los datos, no la pieza
nodes.rationale: El peor caso entra por la misma puerta que los datos reales; nunca se toca ui/Data/Categories/ ni el código de la pieza.

nodes.label: El XAML va como aquí-string literal y no puede llamar a T
nodes.norm_label: el xaml va como aqui-string literal y no puede llamar a t

nodes.label: Admin gating of steps (-RequiresAdmin, effective selection)
nodes.norm_label: admin gating of steps (-requiresadmin, effective selection)
nodes.rationale: Meant to run elevated; without rights, steps needing them are unticked, disabled, flagged and kept out of the queue. In Internet only three work without rights - verified, not assumed (nbtstat -R fails yet returns 0). Effective selection = Test-StepSelected (ticked AND Test-StepAvailable). Tests force elevation with Set-AppElevationOverride.

nodes.label: Step-run queue (120 ms DispatcherTimer, state in $StepRun)
nodes.norm_label: step-run queue (120 ms dispatchertimer, state in $steprun)
nodes.rationale: The window never freezes: each tick does ONE thing (close the finished step, follow the pause, start the next); .cmd pauses become -PauseAfter. Without a message loop the timer never ticks, so tests call Invoke-StepRunTick by hand. State lives in $StepRun, not in controls, so Sync-StepRunPanel shows the same after a language switch or leaving and returning mid-run.

nodes.label: Adding a language (Register-Language, LanguageIndex)
nodes.rationale: Each Lang file is an 'English text' -> 'translation' dictionary; copy es.ps1 and add a line to LanguageIndex.ps1. Get-MissingTranslations 'es' returns exactly what is missing because T records every request. Language names are never translated (TranslateOptions = $false in 10-Language.ps1).

nodes.label: Preferences: Settings screen built from ui/Data/Preferences
nodes.norm_label: preferences: settings screen built from ui/data/preferences
nodes.rationale: Adding an option is creating a Register-Preference file; the view is untouched. Type Toggle or Choice (Options fixed or a scriptblock); Get/Set use Get-AppSetting / Set-AppSetting.

nodes.label: User data and activity log export
nodes.norm_label: user data and activity log export
nodes.rationale: settings.json holds only UI preferences. The log can be exported by user action; cleanup detail (user file paths, recycle bin names) is written only with the 'Con detalle' checkbox. No telemetry, no outbound network.

nodes.label: Preferences persist via Set-AppSetting (%APPDATA% settings.json)
nodes.rationale: Never next to the .exe: it is portable and may sit in a folder without write permission. A corrupt JSON is ignored and defaults are used.

nodes.label: Navegación y estado: Show-View, el log no es vista, Set-AppSetting
nodes.norm_label: navegacion y estado: show-view, el log no es vista, set-appsetting

nodes.label: All visible text goes through T (source-text keyed translation)
nodes.norm_label: all visible text goes through t (source-text keyed translation)
nodes.rationale: English is the source and translation is by original text, not key. A literal without T stays English and never appears in Get-MissingTranslations - a silent failure. XAML cannot call T: its texts are set in TitleBar.ps1.
